candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement that adds msg.value to the caller's balance so Deposit logs but never credits the deposit.
Overwrite the caller's balance with msg.value instead of accumulating, so prior deposits are lost.
Credit the caller with a fixed amount of 1 wei instead of the deposited msg.value.
Change the overflow-guard require to always fail, so Deposit reverts and balances is never updated.
Credit msg.value + 1 to the caller's balance instead of msg.value.
Delete the initialized check so MinSum can be set even after initialization.
Delete the assignment so MinSum is never updated.
Replace the assignment with an accumulation so repeated calls before initialization yield the sum of values.
Replace the assignment with MinSum = 0 so any attempted set leaves MinSum unchanged at zero.
Remove the guard so MinSum can be changed even after the contract is initialized.
Store _val + 1 instead of _val so the observed MinSum always differs from the argument.
Store 0 instead of _val so MinSum is always set to zero.
Remove the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so the log file address can be changed even after initialization.
Replace the assignment target value with the contract's own address, so `SetLogFile()` returns address(this) instead of `_log`.
Replace the assignment to `Log` with setting it to the zero address, so `SetLogFile()` returns address(0) instead of `_log`.
Add an extra statement marking the contract as initialized, so any subsequent SetLogFile call reverts and the stored log address differs from the original behavior.
